expectations.text: Recommends against adopting date-based account-pinned versioning for this team rather than drafting the policy around it as asked.
expectations.evidence: "Recommendation: URI major versioning (/v1/, /v2/), not Stripe-style date-stamped, account-pinned versioning."

expectations.text: States the conditions that would justify account-pinned versioning (breaking changes wanted many times a year plus a long tail of integrators that cannot be forced to migrate) and observes that neither holds for Ledgerbird.

expectations.text: Describes account-pinning's ongoing engineering cost as a chain of per-breaking-change compatibility/transformer modules that must be maintained indefinitely.

expectations.text: Recommends URI path major versioning (/v1-style) as the appropriate scheme for this case.

expectations.text: States a ranking of scheme options in terms of value per unit of effort explicitly in prose, not merely implied by the order options are listed in.

expectations.text: Uses the hard end-of-Q1 deadline for the queued breaking change as an argument favoring the low-machinery scheme.
